verses.saheeh: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
verses.khattab: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did We not expand (an interrogative meant as an affirmative, in other words, ‘We did [indeed] expand’) your breast for you, O Muhammad (s), by means of prophethood and otherwise,
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi) kya humne tumhara seena tumhare liye khol nahin diya

verses.saheeh: And We removed from you your burden
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumpar se woh bhari bojh utar diya

verses.saheeh: Which had weighed upon your back
verses.khattab: which weighed so heavily on your back
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that which weighed down your back? — this is similar to where God says: that God may forgive you what is past of your sin [Q. 48:2].
verses.romanUrdu: Jo tumhari qamar todhe daal raha tha

verses.saheeh: And raised high for you your repute.
verses.khattab: and elevated your renown for you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did We not exalt your mention? For you are mentioned where I [God] am mentioned in the call announcing [the time for] prayer (adhān), in the [second] call to perform the prayer (iqāma), in the witnessing [‘there is no god but God, Muhammad is His Messenger’] (tashahhud), in the Friday sermon and in other instances.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhare khatir tumharey zikr ka awazah buland kar diya

verses.saheeh: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
verses.khattab: So, surely with hardship comes ease
verses.romanUrdu: Pas haqeeqat yeh hai kay tangi kay saat farakhi bhi hai

verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly with hardship comes ease: the Prophet (s) suffered much hardship at the hands of the disbelievers, but then he enjoyed ease when he was assisted to victory [by God] over them.
verses.romanUrdu: Beshak tangi kay saath farakhi bhi hai

verses.saheeh: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
verses.khattab: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So when you are finished, from [performing] prayer, toil, exert yourself in supplication [to God],
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza jab tum faarig ho to Ibadat ki mushakkat mei lag jao

verses.saheeh: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
verses.khattab: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and seek, devote yourself humbly to, your Lord.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur apne Rubb ki taraf raagib ho
